text:
violet tran: Quick update01 I'm refreshing the 'hello-lite' quickstart to match SDK v8 auth helpers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3708. Running locally I hit a 401.

omar rivas: likely the REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY rename. What's in the README/Dockerfile?

violet tran: README and Dockerfile both referenced REDWOOD_TOKEN. Also the example used old `newClient()` call.

jess rao: swap to createClientFromEnv() and show a tiny env export. Keep examples short so they fit the quickstart skim.

violet tran: plan: replace env var, update helper call, add Node + Python snippets, and add Dockerfile ARG example + secrets note.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #3708 01 lint, linkcheck.

docs-bot: linkcheck: warning: docs/quickstart/hello-lite.md line 30 -> https://old-auth.example (redirect).

omar rivas: update link to /docs/auth and add a brief KMS pointer to /enterprise/kms for customers using instance credentials.

violet tran: added snippets and the bash export block:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<YOUR_KEY>
```
Node snippet:
```js
import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClientFromEnv();
const r = await client.generate({model:'redwood-v1', prompt:'hi'});
console.log(r.text);
```
Python snippet:
```py
from redwood_inference import create_client_from_env
client = create_client_from_env()
res = client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='hi')
print(res.text)
```

jess rao: add admonition: "Do not bake secrets into images; prefer runtime injection or BuildKit secrets." and link to /docs/security/secrets.

violet tran: added admonition and restored `ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY` in Dockerfile example. Also noted KMS cross-link.

docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #3708. Ready for review.

jess rao: LGTM, merging. Please open follow-up issue to add a CI smoke test that builds quickstarts (no real keys).

violet tran: Will open the issue after merge. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
